knownFailures.request-json/blank-canonical: SmartRequest.kt rejects the whole request; the item should be unsupported (SEL-10)
knownFailures.request-json/content-kind-not-string: SmartRequest.kt coerces a numeric kind with optString instead of rejecting the request (REQ-2)
knownFailures.request-json/form-no-source: SmartRequest.kt rejects the whole request; the item should be unsupported (FORM-1, REQ-2)
knownFailures.request-json/questionnaire-wrong-type: SmartRequest.kt rejects the whole request; the item should be unsupported (FORM-1, REQ-2)
